- $w_j$ = size (Weight) per unit of air conditioner type $j$ (Weight from file_1_view_0, indexed by ProductName)

Decision variables:

\[
\max \sum_{i \in I} \sum_{j \in J} v_j \cdot x_{ij}

\sum_{j \in J} w_j \cdot x_{ij} \leq c_i \qquad \forall i \in I
